important_limitation: X-learner and regularized T-learner remain substantially lower-root-PEHE controls than CM-OSR across clean, severe-overlap, missingness, and null-effect conditions.

allowed_now: CM-OSR outperformed capacity-matched early-fusion and generic multimodal DR architectures across the prespecified semi-synthetic stress conditions.
Support-based selective retention reduced CM-OSR root-PEHE as lower-support cases were removed.
The benchmark-only 90% CATE bands achieved approximately nominal coverage on known semi-synthetic tau.
not_allowed_now: CM-OSR is the best overall HTE estimator or state of the art.
CM-OSR degrades more gracefully than generic attention/MoE under missingness.
CM-OSR passes the null-effect negative control.
CM-OSR is robust to cross-study shift.
Real-trial intervals are patient-level ITE confidence intervals.

reason_strong_Q1_not_ready: H2 is mixed rather than fully supported.
The null-effect negative control is materially weaker for CM-OSR than X/T learners.
Cross-study shift and H3 remain untested.
Remaining prespecified mechanism ablations A4/A5/A6/random-router and A8 should be completed before final novelty claims.
